name: Arc Sigurdsson-Wickramasinghe

physical_description.heritage: Truly Ubiquitous Diaspora: Northern European (22.9%), East Asian (21.0%), South Asian (17.7%), Hispanic/Latin American (17.4%), Southeast Asian (15.0%), and Sub-Saharan African (6.0%). This rare global blend creates a unique phenotype — Northern European ancestry contributes bone structure refinement and cool undertones; East Asian heritage defines eye shape and high cheekbone prominence; South Asian ancestry enriches skin depth with warm mid-tones; Hispanic/Latin American heritage adds warmth and mid-melanin distribution; Southeast Asian ancestry refines facial proportions and contributes to eye shape complexity; Sub-Saharan African ancestry deepens overall pigmentation and strengthens jaw definition. The result is a complexion that shifts dimensionally with light — warm golden-bronze in neutral light, deepening to rich mahogany in sunlight, with subtle cool undertones visible in shadow.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular, shoulders broad but not bulky. Decades of moving through tight spaces and maintaining low profiles have kept him wiry rather than muscular. Moves with economical precision.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with faint cataracts forming at edges — signs of age and too many years squinting through scope sights
physical_description.skin_tone: Dimensionally warm bronze with golden undertones in neutral light, deepening to rich mahogany in sun-exposed zones. Melanin distribution reflects balanced global ancestry — warm mid-tones from South Asian and Hispanic/Latin American heritage balanced against cooler undertones from Northern European ancestry. Weathered to a matte finish with visible texture from decades of industrial exposure.
physical_description.complexion: Intricate facial structure reflecting six-region ancestry: squared jawline with definition from Sub-Saharan and South Asian heritage; prominent, angular cheekbones from East Asian and Northern European ancestry; distinctive almond-shaped eye set from Southeast and East Asian influence with warm-toned eyelids; warm midtone undertones characteristic of Hispanic/Latin American and South Asian ancestry blending. Deep lines around eyes and mouth carved by decades of life. Scar bisecting left eyebrow, skin bearing the texture of someone who works outdoors in industrial weather. Stubble always present — pragmatic rather than styled.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scar running 8cm down the left temple, partially hidden by hairline, result of a cortex jack installation
Burn scarring across the back of his right hand, silvered and smooth, old enough to predate most of his current augmentations
Small triangular tattoo on his left wrist in faded indigo — a maker's mark from a Tier-5 clinic, specific enough to identify him to those who know what it means
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None obvious. A faint whirring occasionally audible beneath his left ear suggests subcutaneous neural processing. No chrome visible — he dresses and maintains himself deliberately invisible.
physical_description.posture_movement: Upright but not rigid. Moves with minimal wasted motion, always aware of exits. Hands positioned low and neutral. Eyes track rooms methodically. Sits with his back to walls. Speaks in measured sentences with long pauses — listening costs nothing.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier-3 practical wear: charcoal thermal undershirt, unmarked gray composite jacket with internal pockets, dark pants with reinforced knees, worn Black Archon steel-toe boots. A single piece of jewelry — a faded copper wedding band on his left ring finger, worn smooth. Carries a worn canvas satchel, contents unknown. No logos, no status symbols. Everything chosen to disappear into crowds.
